page.description: Recurring work definitions that materialize into auditable execution tasks.
page.createHint: After creation, Paperclip takes you straight to trigger setup. Draft routines stay paused until you add a default agent.

history.restoreDescription: This creates a new revision {{newNumber}} with the same content as revision {{sourceNumber}}. Revisions {{sourceNumber}}–{{currentNumber}} stay in history and are not modified.
history.fieldsRevert: Routine field values, variables, and schedule cron will revert.
history.webhookRecreated: The webhook trigger {{label}} will be recreated with a new URL and secret. Paperclip will show the secret once after restore — copy it before closing.

editor.defaultAgentRequired: Default agent required. This routine can stay as a draft and still run manually, but automation stays paused until you assign a default agent.
editor.previewAssumption: Preview assumes the previous run is still in flight when the next fires. Times shown in {{timeZone}}.
editor.noSchedulePreview: No enabled schedule trigger to preview. Add a schedule in Triggers to see how this policy treats upcoming fires.

coalesce_if_active.title: Coalesce if active
coalesce_if_active.description: Keep one follow-up run queued while an active run is still working.

always_enqueue.title: Always enqueue
always_enqueue.description: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if several runs stack up.

skip_if_active.title: Skip if active
skip_if_active.description: Drop overlapping trigger occurrences while the routine is already active.

skip_missed.title: Skip missed
skip_missed.description: Ignore schedule windows that were missed while paused.

enqueue_missed_with_cap.title: Enqueue missed with cap
enqueue_missed_with_cap.description: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.

always.title: Run on every scheduled tick
always.description: Fire on the schedule no matter what — the default behavior.

require_external_activity.title: Skip when there's been no activity since the last run
require_external_activity.description: On a scheduled tick, only run if something happened since the last run that finished. Lets a watcher-style routine stay asleep while the system is settled instead of burning tokens.

company.title: Company-wide
company.description: Any activity across the company counts as a reason to run.

project.title: This project
project.description: Only activity in the routine's project counts as a reason to run.
